sn20.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati.
sn20.10:1.4: mā āyasmā ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjīti.
sn20.10:1.6: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn20.10:1.7: idha bhante aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati
sn20.10:1.9: mā āyasmā ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjīti
sn20.10:2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave viḷāro sandhisamalasaṅkatire ṭhito ahosi mudumūsiṃ āgamayamāno
sn20.10:2.2: yatthāyaṃ mudumūsi gocarāya pakka missati tattheva naṃ gahetvā khādissāmīti.
sn20.10:2.3: atha kho bhikkhave mudumūsi gocarāya pakkāmi.
sn20.10:2.4: tamenaṃ viḷāro gahetvā sahasā maṃsaṃ khāditvā ajjhohari.
sn20.10:2.5: tassa sā mudumūsi antampa khādi antaguṇampi khādi.
sn20.10:2.6: so tatonidānaṃ maraṇampi nigacchati maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
sn20.10:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anu paṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi
sn20.10:3.2: tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunni vatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā
sn20.10:3.3: tassa mātugāmaṃ disvāna dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti
sn20.10:3.4: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigacchati maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.10:3.5: maraṇaṃ so taṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
sn20.10:3.6: maraṇa mattaññeva bhikkhave dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati
sn20.10:3.9: rakkhitena kāyena rakkhitāya vācāya rakkhitena cittena upaṭṭhitāya satiyā saṃvutehi indriyehi gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmāti
